connectionsBridge.goal: FlutterFlow talks to one governed Pandora owner API. The backend routes to connected MCPs/services; Simple mode does not expose raw MCP/provider jargon or client-side provider secrets.

doesNotAuthorize: publishing a build that fails the recorded release gates

unattendedExecution.outcome: Finish the existing FlutterFlow app without requiring the owner's browser session, using FlutterFlow's official Project API and signed AI SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase email authentication and logout are wired in the existing project.
FlutterFlow calls only the governed Pandora owner API and never contains service-role or provider credentials.
Home, projects, connections, approvals, activity, safety, and Ask Pandora use truthful live responses with loading, empty, error, and offline-safe behavior.
The approved monochrome Pandora's Box mark is used without recolor or reinterpretation.
The official FlutterFlow validator passes before provider mutation.
Android-first responsive, navigation, auth, API, and AAL2 approval checks pass before release.
Deployment and live verification are bound to an exact tested candidate with a recorded rollback point.
nonGoals: Direct client access to provider secrets or individual MCP services.
Weakening owner/admin scope, RLS, MFA, approval, or audit controls.
Inventing completion, connection health, or production verification from placeholder data.
unattendedExecution.credentialBoundary: A GitHub-hosted runner may receive the Vault token only through a signed GitHub OIDC JWT plus a single-use, exact-repository/ref/workflow/commit grant expiring within 15 minutes. The token is masked, never committed or uploaded, and the broker is retired after the final run.
unattendedExecution.risk: FlutterFlow project mutation can affect the existing app; every apply is preceded by official validation and exact provider backup/read-back.
unattendedExecution.rollback: Restore the last verified FlutterFlow snapshot/version and retire the OIDC broker to a verify_jwt=true 410 stub. Database grant records remain only as redacted audit evidence.
